item.text: {"explanation":"Accepted receives add each listed grant once. Fresh sends and spends debit available once; spends increase spent, while sends remain permanently recorded and are refundable only while pending. Acknowledging a pending send makes it delivered without refund; cancelling refunds exactly once. Receive, send, and spend identities use separate namespaces, and all reported identity arrays are sorted by Unicode code points.","program":"function solve(x){var c=x.config,e=x.event,s=x.state;if(s===null){s={a:c.initial,sp:0,g:[],sn:[],wn:[]}}var ty=e&&e.type,id=e&&e.id,amt=e&&e.amount,st='invalid',has=typeof id==='string',pos=Number.isSafeInteger(amt)&&amt>0;function own(o,k){return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(o,k)}function find(a,k){for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(a[i].id===k)return i;return-1}function cp(a,b){var x=Array.from(a),y=Array.from(b),n=Math.min(x.length,y.length);for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var u=x[i].codePointAt(0),v=y[i].codePointAt(0);if(u!==v)return u-v}return x.length-y.length}function sorted(a){return a.sort(cp)}if(ty==='receive'&&has&&pos){var gi=own(c.grants,id),ri=s.g.indexOf(id);if(ri>=0)st=amt===c.grants[id]?'duplicate':'invalid';else if(gi&&amt===c.grants[id]){s.g.push(id);s.a+=amt;st='accepted'}}else if((ty==='send'||ty==='spend')&&has&&pos){var ar=ty==='send'?s.sn:s.wn,j=find(ar,id);if(j>=0)st=ar[j].amt===amt?'duplicate':'conflict';else if(s.a<amt)st='insufficient';else{s.a-=amt;ar.push({id:id,amt:amt});if(ty==='send')ar[ar.length-1].p=true;else s.sp+=amt;st='accepted'}}else if((ty==='ack'||ty==='cancel')&&has){var k=find(s.sn,id);if(k>=0&&s.sn[k].p){s.sn[k].p=false;if(ty==='cancel')s.a+=s.sn[k].amt;st='accepted'}else st='ignored'}var p=[],r=s.g.slice();for(var z=0;z<s.sn.length;z++)if(s.sn[z].p)p.push(s.sn[z].id);sorted(p);sorted(r);return{state:s,output:{available:s.a,spent:s.sp,pending:p,received:r,status:st}}}" }
